post.description: Generates alt text for a new image in AltText.Ai.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

async.description: When true, queue the image for background processing and return immediately.

gptPrompt.description: Optional English prompt containing `{{AltText}}` to rewrite the generated alt text.

image.description: The image payload. Provide either a public `url` or base64 `raw` image data, with optional `asset_id`, `tags`, or `metadata` inside this object.

keywords[].description: Optional SEO keywords or phrases for the generated alt text.

keywordSource.description: Source text to mine for keywords when you do not provide the `keywords` array.

lang.description: One or more language codes, such as `en` or `en,es,fr`, for generated alt text.

maxChars.description: Limit the generated alt text length between 80 and 500 characters.

modelName.description: Choose the AltText.ai language model, such as `describe-regular` or `describe-terse`.

overwrite.description: When true, regenerate alt text for an existing image with the same URL or asset ID.

timeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for generation, between 5 and 30.

webhookUrl.description: Optional webhook URL override for this request.
